messages:
Nia (CS): Quick capture from today's onboarding calls  two repeating asks: (1) procurement wants an easy CSV mapping route -> tokens -> cost, (2) embedding latency spikes hurting search UX. @Owen @Kai can we triage?

Lila (AM): Confirmed. Buyer asked for a sample export they can hand to finance. Said: "without a per-feature breakdown we can't justify the spend."

signal-bot: New signal recorded: "route-cost-export-request" (id=8812).

Kai (Eng): For embedding lag, can we get tenant traces? Could be KV cache TTL or tiny batch sizes. If it's infra we can push a quick config.

Owen (PM): Proposed split: short-term: canned CSV export template + one-pager for AMs; run targeted perf checks on flagged tenants. long-term: console view for per-route consumption & cost and embedding latency SLO charts.

Owen (PM): Owners: @Lila get invoice sample & customer comms, @Nia publish AM one-pager, @Kai run perf surface (2-3h). I'll add a triage card and add ARR/renewal date.

Lila (AM): I'll attach the invoice and draft the CSV mapping by EOD.

Kai (Eng): Starting perf runs now. Will post results and any quick fix proposals in this thread.

Nia (CS): Added to CS signals board https://redwood.internal/cs-signals/3001234567. Marked per-route export as P1 for the at-risk renewals. Please drop links to artifacts when ready. :white_check_mark:
